description: Inputs of the zip/libzip listing workload (tracker item R4): every iteration opens the archive, reads size and names of every entry once and closes the archive. tree-1000.zip is synthetic and written by tools/make_zip_listing_archive.py (1,000 stored entries of 16 bytes); test-cp437.zip is the archive of the query workload, copied from ../zip (its names are converted to UTF-8, which is a second allocation per name). SHA256SUMS lists both. The expectation is the output of the native build; no value is written by hand.
